Watch as a LEGO minifigure navigates a complex assembly line, highlighting the innovative Air Max cushioning unit and the shoe's signature design elements. This imaginative journey celebrates the legacy of the Air Max 97 while offering a fresh, playful perspective on sneaker culture.
